responsibility: Implements the AVX10.2-512 min/max intrinsic header for full-width 512-bit vectors and scalars. It provides the `_mm512_minmax_*` family for BF16, FP16, FP32, and FP64 data, including masked and explicit-rounding variants that select among the AVX10.2 min/max comparison modes, making it the dedicated 512-bit API surface for the new configurable min/max instructions.
